nodes.name: EnablePhysicalDeviceAccessOnCtrlAltDel
nodes.title: Enable access to physical device on CtrlAltDel page
nodes.description: Configuring this node gives access to the physical devices used to boot to Cloud PCs from the Ctrl+Alt+Del page for specified users. This node supports these options: 0. Not enabled 1. Enabled.

enum.description: Access to physical device on CtrlAltDel page disabled
Access to physical device on CtrlAltDel page enabled

nodes.name: EnablePhysicalDeviceAccessOnErrorScreens
nodes.title: Enable access to physical device on error screens
nodes.description: Configuring this node gives access to the physical devices used to boot to Cloud PCs from the error screens for specified users. This node supports these options: 0. Not enabled 1. Enabled.

enum.description: Access to physical device on error screens disabled
Access to physical device on error screens enabled
